notes.title: Dual Festivities, Double the Fun: Lunar Dragon & Valentine Skins Out Now!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to kick off this season with a spectacular blend of traditions and festivities! Today, we’re excited to unveil our latest collection of skins, perfectly themed to celebrate both the Lunar New Year and Valentine's Day in style.

[b]Introducing the Lunar New Year Skins:[/b]

[b]Dragon: Bliss[/b]: Embrace the joy of the Lunar New Year with the Dragon: Bliss skin. Adorned with vibrant colors and traditional motifs, this skin symbolizes happiness and good fortune for the year ahead.
[b]Dragon: Fortune[/b]: Embrace the new year with confidence. The Dragon: Fortune skin is a masterpiece designed to bring prosperity, featuring auspicious gold glitters guaranteed to captivate attention in every match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/cc3d60578b6a7ec16f2ae1346da5598730a4337a.png[/img]
 
[b]Oriental Sky and Ground: [/b]Discover the magic of oriental landscape – Transform your game world with the serene beauty of an Eastern-inspired sky, and a ground teeming with intricate, culturally rich structures and patterns.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/f61066c562c9db24f2f39e5cb747f0d2e3acb8c6.png[/img]
 
[b]And Celebrating Valentine's Day:[/b]

[b]Kozarog: Evil Queen: [/b]Embrace your darker side with the Kozarog: Evil Queen skin. This skin blends the allure of mystery with a touch of romantic goth, ideal for players who like to rule the game with a firm yet loving hand.
[b]Achilles: [/b]Eros: Channel the spirit of the god of love with Achilles: Eros. This skin combines the strength of a warrior with the charm of a romantic hero, offering a unique twist for your gaming sessions.

[b]Goro The Giant: Heartbeat [/b]– Show your softer side with this gentle giant’s skin. Adorned with heart motifs and a warm, inviting love palette, it’s a unique mix of strength and love.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/d1f6691bce1e207f9fabc861ba15dfd88ad00053.png[/img]
 
Each skin in our Dual Festivities collection is crafted with attention to detail and thematic accuracy, ensuring that you stand out in the game with style and flair.

Join the discussion in Discord:
https://discord.gg/TRx5T965cq

notes.title: Power Up Your Arsenal!
notes.content:
Attention, ARBS battlers! Get ready to elevate your arsenal with our latest game update. We're bringing in the big guns – literally! Introducing a range of heavy-duty weapons that will redefine your combat experience. Check out what's new:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/27625c50f220d1472f589cc2388a9c3c891ac350.png[/img]
 
Incendiary Rocket - Ignite the battlefield! Our Incendiary Rockets will set the arena ablaze, creating zones of fiery destruction. Perfect for flushing out entrenched enemies.

Railgun - Precision and power! The Railgun offers unmatched accuracy with devastating impact. One shot, one incredible obliteration.

Plasma Cannon - Sci-fi warfare at its finest. The Plasma Cannon emits a high-energy blast capable of melting through the toughest armors. Feel the thrill of futuristic combat!

Ground Missile - Dominate the land battle. Our Ground Missiles are designed for maximum impact against ground targets. No bunker is safe!

Flamethrower - Close-quarters chaos. Unleash a continuous stream of fire and watch as enemy defenses crumble in fear.

Anti-air Missile - Control the skies. With Anti-air Missiles, you can intercept and destroy airborne threats with unerring precision.

Ion Shield - Defense meets technology. Activate the Ion Shield for an impenetrable barrier against incoming attacks, turning your defense into an offense.

Automatic Gun Turret - Set it and forget it. These turrets provide continuous fire support, fortifying your positions and keeping enemies at bay.

Each weapon comes with its unique tactical advantage, ready to be mastered by skilled battlers. Experiment with different strategies, combine them for maximum effect, and dominate the battlefield like never before!
Upgrade, Adapt, Overcome!
This update isn't just about firepower. It's about bringing a new depth to your tactical planning and enjoyment. So gear up, get ready, and let the battles begin!
 
Join the discussion in Discord:
https://discord.gg/TRx5T965cq

notes.title: Saddle Up: 1st Person Combat!
notes.content:
Attention Battlers! Prepare to saddle up and dive deeper into the ARBS battlefield than ever before. We're thrilled to announce our Saddle Pack!

Ride & Witness: These aren't just your typical skins. With the Saddle Pack, you're not only adorning your animals with stunning new looks but also unlocking the power to enter the 1st person perspective. Feel every charge, every roar, and every attack.

Introducing the Saddle Pack: Eight animals will receive the saddle treatment first:

[b]Dragon: Skyrider[/b]

Soar high and dive deep! Glide through the skies, feeling the rush of wind and the thrill of aerial combat.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/c78604db1691836b2c8bd24765cd3b4dded90c92.png[/img]

[b]Triceratops: Outlaw[/b]

Charge with might! Feeling the earth rumble with every step of this horned giant.

[b]Goro The Giant: Skullstride[/b]

Stand tall and strike fiercely! Dominate the battlefield with each commanding slam.

[b]Gorgon: Totem[/b]

Delve into its power with scales that shimmer and eyes that captivate any onlooker.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/3fe51cab493b87e40f4a53d9b6f64598ad99254b.png[/img]

[b]Carnotaurus: Stallion[/b]

A combination of horns and aggression! Immerse in the rush of a fast-paced hunt.

[b]T-Rex: Lonestar[/b]

Feel the raw power and unmatched ferocity of the apex predator.

[b]Hippopotamus: Voyager[/b]

Experience each swift maneuver and rapid acceleration.

[b]Giant Mantis: Ivory Edge[/b]

Enter the world of a deadly predator and embrace the precision of nature's ultimate hunter.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/cb4d4ea02b0280f8fb8119c434be9c7d9a90a81b.png[/img]

How to Change View: In battle, simply select the animal and press the “f” key to transition to 1st person view, immersing yourself instantly in the core of the action.

Enter the battlefield like never before. With the Saddle Pack, every fight becomes personal. Charge forth, Battlers, command the battlefield from a thrilling new perspective!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/3d4c6107d2fdf4d8bb080704cacdc4518a8ccfb4.png[/img]

Let us know what you think in the comments, have fun battling. We hope to make ARBS even bigger, and better than before!

https://discord.gg/TRx5T965cq

notes.title: ARBS 1.0 has arrived!!!
notes.content:
The full release day has finally arrived everyone!

After being in early access for almost 2 years, Animal Revolt Battle Simulator has finally graduated to version 1.0. What started off as a simple animal battle simulator has over time evolved into a full blown anything versus anything battle simulator game equipped with one of the most flexible and powerful unit creators on the market. 

We're really proud of how ARBS turned out in the end and we wouldn't have been able to do any of that without our dedicated fanbase so we'd like to thank you guys so much for all your support and feedback over the years! You guys are truly awesome and it has been an absolute pleasure making this game for you!

We're sure you can't wait to find out what's inside this week's update so lets get to it!

First please welcome a new awesome addition to the ancient humans faction, the powerful Achilles! Check out the things he can do with his magical sword and shield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/cd673b48a35bd79b26307ee1582fb49d29372084.png[/img]

The carnivore dinosaurs faction has also been expanded with the blood-thirsty carcharodontosaurus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/a7933b73ce1cc2a1f0f54573da5d686091d7b701.png[/img]

The aquatics have definitely been missing one more unit in their ranks so today we are adding the ferocious mutant megalodon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/e65a4e18f573a19d2b0ca5cba7cb33db9743136d.png[/img]

Have any of you guys wished that ARBS also had vehicles in the game? Well, now you can make your own vehicles with the addition of the four wheeler in the robotic base section!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/1b2abb6f41af7fbef0915c46fa7c0e595bda5d7f.png[/img]

We've noticed that a lot of you enjoy building maps with all kinds of castles or military forts. So to make it easier for you, ARBS now has a new building section called "Fort". This will give you plenty of building blocks specifically tailored for fort building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/a8d0f885b67c7e04061783eae2941dceb69045d3.png[/img]

This is a pretty sizable update so we hope we've given you enough to enjoy the game for many days!

Have fun and see you next time!

Hello again!

After weeks of adding stuff to the Unit Creator, we've decided to go back to adding new units. 

For this Halloween, we have a cool new unit for you to play with. Please welcome our new addition to the infernals: Headless Hulk!

Headless Hulk will be our last land unit. In two weeks' time, we'll be adding the last aerial unit which will be the most powerful creature in ARBS yet!

For the Christmas update we'll be finally adding a new biome and with it new sets of creatures. We can't wait to show it all to you!

Have fun and happy Halloween!

notes.title: Battle Robots have arrived in ARBS!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

For this week's update, we've decided to go a bit more robotic and so we've added some cool new things for you to play with in the Unit Creator!

- new robotic bases
- robotic parts
- flames as decorations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/9ee42e0422cfbba3849278cae60a92e8e9484ca0.png[/img]

You can now hold down the Z key for slower and more accurate rotation and scaling. This should be quite useful for those of you who love creating awesome creatures using the Unit Creator!

And lastly, we fixed the issue with deleting things inside the carnivore heads.

Have fun with the new features and we'll see you in two weeks' time for a special Halloween update!

notes.title: Skeleton dino parts in the Unit Creator!
notes.content:
Hello again!

In this update, we've decided to add some new stuff to the unit creator. You can build skeleton dinosaurs now with some cool new skeleton dino body parts:

- skulls of carnotaurus, T-Rex, triceratops, sauropod
- theropod skeleton torso
- theropod skeleton base, triceratops skeleton base, sauropod skeleton base
- two skeleton dino tails

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/cbbd1deab44888229f69fd17175122c2d3553d99.png[/img]

We've also added some extra skins for Goro the giant!

Have a great time with ARBS and see you again in 3 weeks!

notes.title: Goro the giant remastered! ARBS on mobile!
notes.content:
Hello again!

We're bringing you some big announcements today! As some of you have read in the previous announcement, ARBS is now available on the Google Play Store. We're hard at work now for the IOS release and this should come within the next week or two.

Most of our time was preoccupied with the mobile port but we haven't forgotten about our Steam fans. Today we would like to introduce to you: a remastered Goro the giant! His looks and moves have been polished up now so go check him out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/c1971f7cd01c5f893346c3769e5ba5b0f745de11.png[/img]

Next update in 3 weeks' time, see you then! Have fun!

notes.title: Flame throwers and more unit creator goodies!
notes.content:
Hello again!

In this week's update we're bringing you more cool stuff to the unit creator!

The following has been added:

 1) Infernal heads - hellhound, kozarog 
 2) Reptile Heads - titanoboa, purrusaurus
 3) Fantasy Bases - wyvern
 4) Reptile Bases - purrusausus
 5) Purrusarusus tail
 6) Flamethrower 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/ddd574d05cdc9de79b3ee3d6e2eb8cbce16ea64b.png[/img]

We're preparing a slightly bigger update next time so it will be released in about 3 weeks' time on Thursday, 2nd of September!

Have fun folks!

notes.title: Adding jet packs to ARBS!
notes.content:
Greetings everybody!

In this week's update, we've re-skinned three more creatures that definitely needed some appearance refresh: werewolf, emperor scorpion, and pachycephalosaurus.

The unit creator now has attachable jet engines! Time to make some flying jet monsters you guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/471ea36ad9d52d8bcf76d355799b0f0d19a6d2c0.png[/img]

We've also added a rocket launcher battery which all pyromaniacs will love!

The shields section now has a few extra options for you to pick from.

Have fun!

notes.title: Minotaur remastered and cool new unit creator stuff!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this week's update, we've decided to freshen to look of some existing animals. The minotaur has been remastered and the saltwater crocodile and green anaconda have been re-skinned!

The unit creator now has rotators under the Gear section. Attach some spikes to these rotators and see what it does to your enemies! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/4028d3615a85116e4b02d9de9263fa09b878ca74.gif[/img]

There are extra metal blocks under the Armor section which can be quite useful with the rotators.

The robotic base "A Box" now has a static version.

We've added Y-Invert and X-Invert for the camera rotation.

Some of you had some problems with prefabs appearing as little huts. This issue should be resolved now.

Lastly, we've fixed an issue with the escape AI for animal bases herding in one direction after some time.

Have fun and till next time!

notes.title: Scourge of the earth is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this week's update, we're finally giving you the creature that quite a few of you have been asking about for the last few months. This is the most powerful addition to the infernals faction and to ABRS in general. Please welcome the Scourge!

We've also added a few cool things to the unit creator that will light up your battle scenes. You can now add glowing eyes to your creatures and also sparkles. You can make a proper Phoenix now using the unit creator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/b3163a1c34f3fc2b7a188295b1129f8927a9bb82.png[/img]

We fixed an issue where the units would fly off after pausing and unpausing so hopefully you should no longer see this strange behaviour.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hydra remastered into a 5 headed beast!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

For this update, we've decided to beef up the Hydra, which now has 5 heads! Check out how it wreaks havoc with these 2 extra heads!

We've also added a much-requested feature to the unit creator. That's right, the wings are here! Time to make some flying T-Rexes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/7b249b1747745ee0f41341f7ad7f354858fdd4b5.png[/img]

For fans of castle sieges, we've made a little change to the AI of the ranged units. If you set their AI to Guard, they will stand in one place and shoot. You don't have to worry about archers falling off the walls anymore!

Have fun and see you next time!

notes.title: Giant Praying Mantis and Plasma Cannons!
notes.content:
Greetings animal revolters!

This week we have some seriously cool new things for you to play with!

First please welcome a new mighty addition to the giant invertebrates, the giant praying mantis!

Two new powerful weapons have been added to the unit creator:

- Lightning Gun
- Plasma Cannon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/aa94d10c99e4e048d4be7af424cd5e9020d47821.png[/img]

For fans of Godzilla you can now use the Plasma Beam T-Rex head which can both bite and shoot plasma beams! 

We've noticed that some people still don't know you can use ctrl-z/ctrl-y to undo and redo changes. For this reason we've added the undo/redo buttons to the top menu to make it more obvious that you can undo any unintended changes.

And lastly, the unit creator now has the parasaurolophus torso that you can use in your creations.

Have fun!

notes.title: Ogre Lord joins the infernals!
notes.content:
Hello lovely people!

The last few weeks we've been focusing on the unit creator and no new units were added but today we finally have a new beast for you to play with. Please welcome the Ogre Lord to the infernals faction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/7226f9c4ee3a6b52a14f5a70b9c97571e6c3c0cc.png[/img]

But this is not all of course. We've also added the following to the unit creator:
- Therizinosaurus claws
- Herbivore dinosaur bases
- Herbivore dinosaur heads
- Herbivore dinosaur tails
- Modern mammals bases
- Modern mammals heads

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/5e78706ad22b57e34914ad9986f6d479a9c61d34.png[/img]

We hope you have a great time with these new additions to the game!

notes.title: Carnivore dino parts added to the Unit Creator!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Have you ever dreamt about playing around with a three-headed T-Rex? Well, now you can! We've added some cool new things to the Unit Creator for you to try out!

- new attachable carnivore dinosaur heads. They bite!
- carnivore dinosaur bases
- carnivore dinosaur torsos
- tails and claws added to the Limbs section
- new humanoid bases
- new humanoid heads
- new humanoid torsos

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/fe597471f714e92634dda6b48c6b17eb19359d77.png[/img]

Looks like most people didn't notice it from the last update but for animal bases, you have 3 different AIs to pick from, which are not the same as the usual AIs for animals.

We can't wait to see what cool monsters you can create out of those new parts! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Unit Creator is here!
notes.content:
Hello again!

This week we have added some amazing new features to the game and you're going to absolutely love it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/330f80b529e2f93f2f1a64786d5a9e5ce2adf377.png[/img]

Firstly, we have added a new section to the units selection menu called Unit Creator. All the attachable weapons, armor, and decor will go into this new section. On top of that, we have added four new sub-sections called animal/robotic bases, torsos, and heads. This basically means you can create new units from scratch now! For now, we only have humanoid animal bases, torsos, and heads but more will be added in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/d8a6292f70035ffe17408cdfd88041ca9b84bfe0.png[/img]

A second big feature we've introduced is the ability to attach things to dynamic weapons like tentacles, punchers, or hammer hands. So for example you can attach dynamite to a boxing glove to pack a truly explosive punch! Or add some extra spikes to a tentacle for extra damage. You can even add tentacles to other tentacles, there are no limits now!

Some other new things which have been added:
 - helmets 
 - new spikes 
 - blades
 
Other minor fixes and changes:
 - any bumped-up animal stats are now shown in red. If any attached weapon has an attack multiplier not set to one then a warning will be shown
 - fixed the bug with venom doing excessive damage to animals with increased health
 - you can use the arrow keys now to move the camera
 - small animals with massively increased health are no longer insta-killed by for example a T-Rex

notes.title: Swarming in!
notes.content:
Hello again!

We have some cool new things for you in this week's update. Firstable, please welcome a new addition to the giant invertebrates faction, the swarm bug!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/82cb802643bc7f1afbf3cb90a5d291ab3d829b93.png[/img]

Looks like you are all having a lot of fun creating all sorts of awesome creatures with attached weapons and armor so we've added a few new things for you to play with:

- in the attachable armor section, we've added armored scales
- in the attachable weapons section, we've added boxing gloves
- in the attachable decor section, we've added eyes, hats and sunglasses

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/a7575de84a740eda1ab6d6d9440cc44df263b791.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.content:
Fixed the issue with Lava Golem parts disappearing
Fixed the issue with attachable items not placing correctly on the lava golem
Fixed the issue with the camera movement and rotation getting janky when the game lags

notes.title: New infernal monster and many more features!
notes.content:
Update time everyone!

This week we have quite a few new things to show you!

First off, the infernals are getting another powerful addition. Please welcome the Lava Golem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/5a84640cdb09ae91b140ac06044d61abece0137f.png[/img]

Some people were complaining last week that the Punchers were all left handed. Since ARBS is a righteous game for righteous people, we've added right handed punchers as well now!

Furthermore, you can now attach hands with swords, hammers and spears to the animals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/ca9e9bfe1b9a857034405877a37842d5ecbd904c.png[/img]

To further unlock your creativity we've added the attachable decor section. Right now it contains feathers which you can stick on the animals. This should satisfy any of you who prefer feathered dinosaurs!

You can see the HP and animal properties now by clicking on the "H" and "J" keys. 

Lastly, the battles can be paused now by clicking on the "P" key. Note that the "P" key was previously used to turn on/off the team markings on the animals, so if this is not the first time you're playing ARBS, we suggest you change those key bindings in the settings.

Have fun and till next time!

notes.title: New monstrous reptiles!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've added two new members to the reptile faction. Please welcome the poisonous Komodo Dragon and the bone-crunching Purussaurus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/bf7829ace4b418bac7b0b61775d7b6c0b66cd3f5.png[/img]

If you enjoy building maps then we've got some new things for you to try out:
- new building block colours
- new flags
- new fences

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/8df519e9b13ca4da3b8c20ad86720fec540bc9c1.png[/img]

We've also added some extra filled maps for you to play around with.

Lastly, we've implemented a much-requested feature, which is the ability to redo and undo your actions with CTRL-Z and CTRL-Y. No more annoying and irreversible deletions you didn't intend!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hellhound and more attachable weapons!
notes.content:
Hello again!

At long last we're introducing a new creature to ARBS! Please welcome the fiery Hellhound to the infernals faction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/f5153d0d0bde565f7967a584af5defcb27dee07b.png[/img]

We've also added a few new things for attachable weapons:
- two new armor types
- a new category called organic weapons
- a new category called animal gear. This for now contains platforms which you can attach to a big animal and you can place smaller creatures like archers on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/b17cd46cd5762e55aa3c67bd28a53317d0d4b21e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/0af7e6d2fa3be7af391bfd9a74de84e196305936.png[/img]

For performance reasons we've added an option to stop the weapons/armor detaching from an animal after death. You can do this by going to the map settings (Top right corner icon in the sandbox). 

Have a great time checking out the new updates!

notes.title: Small change to UI and minor fixes
notes.content: Small change to UI and minor fixes

notes.title: Attachable weapons added to the game!
notes.content:
Hello all!

This week we're excited to bring you the biggest update yet for Animal Revolt Battle Simulator!

First, let's start with the slightly bad news. The weaponised animal faction has been removed, so no more dynamite boar and steelnoceros. Rocket Ellie has been moved to the mammals faction.

Now let's move on to the amazing news! We're adding attachable weapons to the game! That's right, you can attach all kinds of weapons and armor to the animals now! You can attach as many weapons as you want and on any part of the animal's body. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/212ef5a1fec1bc9fb1345ccaa11d04e21e1c9ec4.png[/img]

You can save your creations as prefabs so you can re-use them in different battles. You can also upload your creations to the Steam workshop so that other players can try them out! And this also allows you to download weaponised animals created by the other players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/a829088278c37352101bcc854090293d1ec4cf45.png[/img]

Lastly, the campaigns "Human Salvation" and "Rise of the Apes" have been re-done so you should give them a go!

Have a great time weaponising the animals!

notes.title: Mammals and Machimosaurus remastered!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This week we have another round of animal remastering for you!

The wild boar, water buffalo, cape buffalo, hippo, rhino and the elephant have been remastered in the mammals faction! The Machimosaurus also received a nice make over!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/e8a91d2e6c3c53542b3a2041161647e97c052b94.png[/img]

You can place rocks and trees on top of each other now which was not possible before. Animals can also be placed on rocks now.

This is the final remastering update for the time being. We may still do some occasional remasters in the future if necessary.

In two weeks time we'll be releasing a very special update and we can't wait to show it to you, you'll love it!

Have fun!

notes.title: Triceratops and Parasaurolophus remastered!
notes.content:
Welcome back everyone!

We hope you had a good Christmas break despite the challenging pandemic times. 

Some of you must be a bit sad for the holidays to end so to lift your spirits we've got a little update for you!

The Triceratops and Parasaurolophus have been remastered and are so much more fun to play with now!

We're slowly nearing the end of the remastering phase so you should soon see updates containing new features and most importantly, new units!

Have fun!

notes.title: The return of the king! The T-Rex remastered!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This week's update sees the return of the king! The T-Rex has been remastered and looks absolutely stunning! Check out its new moves and see what an absolute beast this carnivore is now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/fa043c012b9187ddc5bdf20afc3a86ca3ae45ac0.png[/img]

The Spinosaurus also received some improvements to its AI so you should definitely try it out!

This is the last update for 2020 so we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it for you!

From all of us here at VDimension, Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

notes.title: Cryolophosaurus the great!
notes.content:
Hi all!

In this update, the Cryolophosaurus was remastered and is no longer the wimp it was before!

It looks better than ever and fights like a real beast!

Next week's update will be a huge one so stay tuned!

Have fun!

notes.title: The Deinonychus, Ankylosaurus and Stegosaurus remastered!
notes.content:
Hello again beautiful people!

We've been hard at work for you guys in the last two weeks, and this time we remastered 3 dinosaurs! 

The Deinonychus, Ankylosaurus, and Stegosaurus have received gorgeous new skins for you to enjoy!

Next week and the week after we'll have two special updates which you're going to love! We can't wait to show it to you!

Have fun!

notes.title: Remastered Allosaurus and Velociraptor!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This update sees the Allosaurus and Velociraptor receiving a cool make over so check them out!

Have fun!

notes.title: Pteranodon and new Carnotaurus!
notes.content:
Hello all!

In this update we're introducing the much requested flying animal. So here it is, please welcome the Pteranodon to our reptiles family!

Our remastering mission continues with the Carnotaurus receiving a much needed makeover!

Enjoy!

notes.title: The dead have arrived!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's almost Halloween time so we're bringing you some awesome new content in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/cd68b63119d26247fff676389c1365302ea826ba.png[/img]

We've added a new faction called the Infernals with three brand new units! Please welcome the Skeleton Warrior, the Saber Ghoul and a truly powerful addition, Kozarog the Demon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/680d52bd3bebe62a10beeb7ed65f3aee38f72414.png[/img]

There is also a new campaign called "Dead Rising" which pits you against the new creatures so give it a go!

We've also added quite a few other things:
 - new landscape maps in the sandbox including an extra large grassland map. 
 - new leafless trees.
 - new cemetery building blocks which includes tombstones and various bones.
 - new triangular building blocks and a new prefab called Mausoleum.

Two quality of life updates:
 - you can change teams now using the number keys on your keyboard.
 - holding the space bar will accelerate your camera movement.

notes.title: Presidential elections mini-update!
notes.content:
Hello again happy people!

With the US presidential elections fast approaching we thought it would be cool to release a little tongue in cheek mini-update this week!

The Hill Giant has two extra skins now, which weirdly resemble two fine gentlemen you see a lot on the news now :)

Enjoy and see you next week when we'll be releasing a special update for Halloween!

notes.title: Brachiosaurus joining the herbivore dinosaurs faction! Spinosaurus remastered!
notes.content:
Hello guys and girls!

We have a new and huge addition to the herbivour dinosaurs faction this week! He's big, angry and ready to crush some enemies! Please welcome, the Brachiosaurus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/0f066cba2d48ad7c4146fc383ca179bf9817f3be.png[/img]

This update also sees the Spinosaurus being remastered. It looks better than ever and his attacks are much more accurate now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/75e33e343f952a576dd5bff6fb1d51aceeaa38ef.png[/img]

In two weeks time there will be a special halloween update, which we can't wait to share with you! 

Until then, have a great time everyone!

notes.title: Hill Giant is here! Titanoboa and Therizinosaurus re-mastered!
notes.content:
Hello animal revolters!

In this week's update we have quite a few cool new additions!

Firstly, please welcome a new member of the fantasy faction, the Hill Giant!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/2e7039f1cab53ac4c7294158384c82b3c016af34.png[/img]

The models for Titanoboa and Therizinosaurus have been re-mastered and their AIs enhanced. You will notice Titanoboa and Therizinosaurus are much more accurate with their attacks now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/c91b8ef92cc63430fff1c0d4ab83c92cf6978381.png[/img]

A new weapon has been added for the FPS Avatar to use, the Pulse Blaster! This little gem can do some real damage so check it out in the two new maps added to the FPS campaign!

And finally, a whole new campaign called "Fantastic Beasts" has been added, which pitches units from the fantasy and reptile factions against other creatures.

Bug fixes:
 - Fixed issue with FPS avatar shooting itself
 - Fixed issue with cursor not locking to one screen

Have fun guys!

notes.title: First person shooting mode added to the game!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This week we have a special update for you, a little experiment to mix things up a bit. We're introducing some light first person shooter elements to the game!

You can now place an FPS avatar on the map and take control of it. You can also place weapons and ammo boxes which you can collect while controlling the FPS avatar. And most importantly you can finally have some fun shooting down dinosaurs and other beasts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/7934662b1cb8d9e08efd242c0a87180df5b4835e.png[/img]

We've also added a whole new campaign for the first person shooter mode! Check out the tutorial campaign which has been updated to teach you how to play with the FPS avatar.

For the next update, we'll go back to adding new creatures but will expand on the FPS mode if it proves popular.

Have a great time!

notes.title: Spartans and Hussars are marching in!!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

In this update, we're introducing two more units in the ancient humans' faction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/64fc08b37245b99f4f7c58fc71cf81883355fcc5.png[/img]

The first one is the Spartan Warrior, another cool infantry unit for you to try out!

The second unit we've added is the first human fighter on horseback! Please welcome the Hussar! A few of those guys charging can wreak havoc among foot soldiers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/431788af21db4584d5c24a01b496ce18dd10ce63.png[/img]

This update also has a cool addition under the "Building" section. You can create animal spawners now! Put a spawner on the map and see animals coming out of it ready to fight!

Have fun!

notes.title: The Wyverns are flying in!!!
notes.content:
Aloha everyone!

This week we are adding another beast to the fantasy faction and you're going to love this one!

Please welcome: the beastly Wyvern!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/5b7e36635c4cc69ed8ea993c3860a4fec31a2a9b.png[/img]

That's right! You can finally play around with a flying creature and our wyvern can do some really cool stuff in the air!

Have a blast!

notes.title: Steam Workshop and the three-headed Hydra are here!
notes.content:
Hello animal revolters!

Steam Workshop has finally arrived! You can share all your building prefabs and maps with the community now! So if you have something cool to show to the other players, PLEASE UPLOAD IT TO THE STEAM WORKSHOP!:) It only takes a few clicks, it's that simple! 

Steam Workshop will also allow you to download the building prefabs and maps created by the other players! We added a tutorial on how to upload/download things from the Steam Workshop so check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/9c1da66aaa40a9dcdac3e09cee5ef694f3be117d.png[/img]

This update also sees another addition to the fantasy faction. And this is a big one! Please welcome the mighty three-headed Hydra to our family of animals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/d70895ec4215d0d298bba03bf022e4196a79f833.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: The sandbox now has a prefab creator for buildings!
notes.content:
Hey all!  

This time we have a very cool update for you in the form of a prefab creator! You can save all your buildings as prefabs now so you can easily re-use them in different maps!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/f4f227838b2e3f81ecd27f794e6cf0dc11d83fc3.png[/img]

We've updated the tutorial to include a section on how to create prefabs and custom maps so check it out!  

The building section in the sandbox now includes doors/gates!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/a232d9f17ecc39c9a71fdc8cebefa9575251b92d.png[/img]

Next week there will be a major update. Apart from new creatures we are also finally adding the Steam Workshop! That's right, you'll finally be able to share your maps and prefabs with other people! And you yourself can try the prefabs and maps created by the other players! 

So if you have some cool buildings or maps, don't delete them! Keep them and share them for others to try out when Steam Workshop comes out next week!  

Enjoy!

notes.title: Minotaur and mighty ancient warriors are here!
notes.content:
Hello warriors!

In this update we have added two more human units: Crixus the Gaul and Teutonic knight. These two together with Archie the Archer and Romanus have been moved to the section called Ancient Humans.

The fantasy faction has a new joiner as well. Please welcome the mighty Minotaur!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/b773fd1ff3e5094f5aa6ff8e63fb9f6ba1fcd4cf.png[/img]

In order to make things easier for you guys to build stuff we have added a section called prefabs. For now you can use 5 different prefabs: hut 1, hut 2, wooden wall, stone wall and small tower. More will be added later on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/3d934e6d377f6a57dce7bd182164f3425295afcc.png[/img]

In the next week's update we will add a prefab creator which will allow you to save everything you build as prefabs. This means that you'll be able to re-use your buildings in different maps without having to start from scratch.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Gorgon and Werewolf are here to rock and roll!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

1. In this update we're introducing two units to the fantasy faction: Gorgon and Werewolf!
We also added the Giraffe to the modern mammals faction.

2. We did a bit of performance optimisation for this release so you should see things running a little more smoothly now with a higher frame rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/e6c62d017c1a57c15c86177e084c0af289e4fb59.png[/img]

3. Palm trees have been added plus the Colorado blue spruce!

4. More bushes have been added.

5. We improved the locking logic for building blocks so it should be much easier to construct things now. Even building blocks with different scales should lock properly. As a reminder, to change the scale of the building blocks press Alt and mouse scroll.

notes.title: Scaling fixed for Animals!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/6d9f1eba3b30b64d85c88b8b670d1f87391390f7.png[/img]

Mini update for this week! 

Scaling for animals was fixed for the most part. You'll still see some weird behaviour if you go a bit too far with the scaling but as long as you keep it within a certain reasonable amount then it should work just fine.

Next week will be a bigger update involving 3 new beasts and some other new things added to the sandbox.

notes.title: June 26th, 2020 update!!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/b4b89573947e12c53680b0dccdffb4477adc90ed.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/f059cd847af17fa5b0111d20437ab173bea1eb3f.png[/img][/url]

Hello everyone! We hope your summer has been great so far!

Here's a summary of new things for this update which we can't wait for you to try out:

1) Path Finding - you can enable path finding in the map settings now! That's right, the animals will be able to avoid obstacles now which means you can create some really cool battles involving buildings, rocks, trees and many other types of objects!

2) Commando Bo can be controlled in first and third person view! We'll add this functionality for other animals in the following weeks.

3) Try the new mini campaign with Commando Bo which teaches you how to go into first/third person mode.

4) Building blocks were dynamic before but now you can mark them as static so you don't have to worry about gravity pulling them down! Once set as static, the building block cannot be moved. This could be useful if you want the animals to be able to do path finding while walking on buildings. You can also create some really intricate structures now and not have to worry about the blocks falling down!

5) You can scale anything now by holding the "ALT" key and mouse scrolling! Scaling animals will lead to strange behaviour so we don't recommend that. Use it for scaling things like trees, rocks, building blocks and so on. 

6) You can add wind effect for trees in the map settings. You'll see the tree leaves weaving with the wind.

7) More rocks have been added and also more filled maps for you to play around with!

8) The cursor now disappears during battle if you are in the free camera rotation mode.
